subject: tight jeans
title: What If Your Jeans Were Too Tight?

scenes.text: What if your jeans were too tight? In 2015, one pair put a woman in hospital.
In Australia, she spent hours squatting to empty cupboards while helping a relative move house.
As her calf muscles swelled, the tight denim wouldn't stretch. It worked like a tourniquet.
Pressure built inside the muscles until it crushed her nerves. Doctors call it compartment syndrome.
Her feet went numb and weak. She fell and couldn't get up. The jeans had to be cut off.
Four days of fluids, and she walked out on her own. The jeans didn't make it.

description:
In a 2015 case report in the Journal of Neurology, Neurosurgery & Psychiatry, a 35-year-old woman in Adelaide spent many hours squatting in tight jeans, developed compartment syndrome and nerve damage in her lower legs, and could not walk.
Her jeans were cut off; after four days of IV fluids she walked unaided.
